Original RAM boundaries remain distinct. Full relevant guards are rounded outward and merged only on overlap or adjacency; capacity overflow refuses.
Four host groups, 93 cases per mode, three same-owner TEST-SDK processes, 17 compiled assertion mutants and 20,610 independent sanitizer cases pass.

Root checked all 24 source files and aggregate hashes, bound dependencies, 22 ARM64 object headers, mixed-link hashes and dependency hashes. Independent review verifies all imports and instructions against the pinned 58da kernel.

limits: Wording qualification: configuration DOES allocate anchor and mutex control objects. It does not acquire backing descriptors, zero/copy backing, retire buffers or issue effects. Frozen source wording was not edited.
The internal callback seam remains trusted and callable; it is not a security boundary. Actual native APIs were not executed by tests or this admission.
Expected hashes are labels, not authentication. Boot quiescence, accessible resident protected code/storage and one physical-domain owner remain caller obligations.
Private VM allocation assumptions plus finite source guards do not establish global exclusion completeness, chip identity, DART/DMA permission, link readiness or Wi-Fi.
Control pages overlapping a conservative boot prefix may legitimately refuse. No hole punching, prefix shrinking or retry is permitted to force success.
